Question: Triangle \(OAB\) has \(O=(0,0),\) \(B=(5,0),\) and \(A\) in the first quadrant. In addition, \(\angle ABO=90^\circ\) and \(\angle AOB=30^\circ.\) Suppose that \(\overline{OA}\) is rotated \(90^\circ\) counterclockwise about \(O.\) What are the coordinates of the image of \(A?\)
